packageName: Aeotec Dual Nano Switch with Power Meter
author: Ricardo Nogueira Garcia
releaseNotes: v1.0.0: first release. Parent driver plus a child driver per channel (Switch + Power Meter + Energy Meter) for the Aeotec Dual Nano Switch ZW132. Power and energy are polled per channel through Z-Wave Multi Channel; no automatic report parameters are changed. The recreateChildren command replaces the children created by the native driver (their Type cannot be changed in the UI); device ids change. Verified on two ZW132 units. A ZW140 (no Meter class) is detected and not polled.

drivers.name: Aeotec Dual Nano Switch with Power Meter

x-catalog.description: Z-Wave driver for the Aeotec Dual Nano Switch (ZW132): a child per channel with switch, power (W) and energy (kWh).
